name: AMD integrated GPU · use swangle rendering (example)
author: ApkStart
description: On some AMD integrated GPUs with older drivers, -gpu host passes the emulator self-test but the guest process crashes shortly after boot (the log only shows "AEHD is operational"). Pinning the renderer to swangle works around it at a small frame-rate cost.

notes: If the picture is fine but games are slow, set Picture quality to 540x960 in Settings
Once you confirm it works, set enabled to true (or delete that line) to apply it automatically
